tweetText: OpenAI rolled out new spend controls and usage analytics for ChatGPT Enterprise, allowing businesses to monitor costs more effectively. This update helps organizations use AI confidently and manage expenses as they scale. via OpenAI News

ChatGPT's latest update, GPT-5.5 Instant, enhances health responses by improving reasoning and clarity, backed by physician insights. This means users get more accurate and reliable health information. via OpenAI News
Elastic is set to acquire DeductiveAI for up to $85M. This deal highlights the growing importance of AI in software development and bug resolution. via TechCrunch AI

AI startup Baseten is reportedly about to raise $1.5 billion, valuing the company at $13 billion. This shows strong investor confidence in AI technologies as the demand for AI inference grows. via TechCrunch AI

Snap is spinning off its AI video team into a new company called Dotmo as part of cost-cutting efforts. This move highlights the growing focus on AI in the video space and Snap's shift in priorities. via TechCrunch AI

OpenAI is gearing up for its IPO by hiring key figures like Transformer co-inventor Noam Shazeer and ex-Trump AI policy official Dean Ball. This move highlights OpenAI's commitment to strengthening its leadership and innovation. via TechCrunch AI

Nearly half of US singles have a negative view of AI in dating, according to Match. This highlights the tension between tech and romance, as many still see value in AI for improving profiles and conversations. via TechCrunch AI
Amazon is aiming to compete with Nvidia by selling its AI chips to other data centers. This could unlock a $50 billion market opportunity for the company. via TechCrunch AI

The government has ordered grid operators to prioritize interconnections for AI data centers. This is significant as it could speed up their growth but doesn't solve existing electricity supply issues. via TechCrunch AI

Karamo Brown from 'Queer Eye' has launched Kē, a wellness app featuring his AI digital clone to support personal growth. This matters because it combines technology with wellness, making self-improvement more accessible. via TechCrunch AI
